Adds the optional Proxima module manifest, Vietnamese usage notes, and a focused PowerShell validation harness. The harness checks a strict data-only manifest AST before import, including executable blocks and background pipelines.

Exact head: `ecd8cee3ea6da6513a37a9b9aa6c9db65472e41c` (tree `ebe647c4bc68fb75b3ad7319a79ad3bf0f143a70`), Packet #1285 r6/g7, Mission #1238. Three new product files, 450 added lines. This head mechanically incorporates canonical bookkeeping from `eefce7fe828a68a13b4b7e3b1e17c1ddb2b6deee` to satisfy admission ancestry; all product blobs remain byte-identical to the prior reviewed H3. Existing S1/S2/core/workflows are unchanged.

Validation on this exact head: Linux selftest1777/1777, strict release verification184/184, Ruff baseline delta0, canonical admission with the actual PR base rc0. Focused native PS5.1/7: baseline7RED, candidate7/7, CX12/12, unchanged S2normal26/26; six AST before-import negatives and an isolated Background-only rollback. Native ZIP SHA256 `62698d77952f85554c4e25649af950edaed95aaeafa1ff0d9d4dad48f6ce0ec9`, all455sourcefiles/39logs/15phases/nested artifacts retained and independently audited.

Fresh independent Codex CLI review4 approved the entire product diff, canonical synchronization, spec and standards/security, with no open findings and F01 whole-class closure. Actual retained executor `gpt-6.1-sol/high`; actual reviewer `gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh`, read-only independent clone/context, higher effort measured. [Original verdict and validated v2 receipt](https://github.com/ducthangho/tra-luat/issues/1285#issuecomment-6729249881). [Frozen r6 specification](https://github.com/ducthangho/tra-luat/blob/4dd7b145e08499ae91df1d8328b39e9d8f9cba24/ops/specs/wp1285-r6.md).

Corrective push2/2 completed after offline approval and exact-head gates. Original H3 admission failure is retained; it is not relabeled as passing. Ubuntu PR CI run42539770394/attempt1 completed successfully: all23jobs passed. Two admission checks and current-head Draft connector review also succeeded. Full-source provenance audit AUX11 is finishing.

CHƯA ĐỦ ĐIỀU KIỆN MERGE: pending completion of the full-source audit and sufficient independent sensitive assurance under protocol §8. Current code approval is same-provider only; higher effort does not create cross-provider or human audit. Keep Draft until the conditions are met. Focused Windows tests above were run; Windows CI/full Windows mutant CI are excluded by owner instruction. No runtime activation or LIVE deployment.
